Subject: Acme Thermal — vendor onboarding documents and bank info

Hi Karthik,

Thanks for taking our onboarding request. Attached are the completed vendor bank form and our current W-9. Can you confirm the best way for us to receive purchase orders and the remittance email you prefer for payment notifications? A few specifics from your side would help us finish our internal setup: 

- Do you require PO numbers on the invoice header or body?
- Preferred invoice/email subject line for automated remittance matching
- Does Redwood require ACH or wire for first-time payments (we can accept either)

Attachments: vendor_bank_form_acme.pdf (PDF, 180KB), W9_Acme_2025.pdf (PDF, 95KB)

If possible, please loop in your AP contact so we can confirm micro-deposit verification steps for ACH.

Best,
Jordan Ellis

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>

Date: Mon, 03 Nov 2025 13:45:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Acme Thermal — vendor onboarding documents and bank info

Jordan — thanks for sending these over and for the quick turnaround. I reviewed the attachments briefly and have looped in Laura (AP) and Marissa (Procurement) to complete setup. A few quick notes / asks so we can move to vendor creation in our ERP: 

1) PO handling: Redwood requires a PO number on the invoice header and in the invoice email subject line so our automation picks it up. Suggested subject: "PO {PO-NUM} — Invoice {Invoice#} — Acme Thermal"

2) Remittance notifications: We prefer remittance emails to go to payments@redwood.ai. If you want us to confirm the exact remittance format (CSV vs. PDF), Laura can confirm.

3) ACH verification: Our AP team will either request a secure DocuSign bank confirmation or send a $0.10 micro-deposit for verification — both are acceptable. Laura, can you proceed with DocuSign for their bank form and advise on micro-deposit amount?

Once AP confirms, I will initiate the PO creation and share PO number and routing. Let us know whether you prefer wire for the first payment; if so, include beneficiary name exactly as on the bank form.

Thanks — Karthik

Karthik Iyer
Senior Procurement Manager
Redwood Inference
karthik_iyer@redwood.ai

From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>

Date: Tue, 04 Nov 2025 10:22:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Acme Thermal — vendor onboarding documents and bank info

Hi Jordan — thanks for the docs. Quick update from AP on next steps: 

- We reviewed vendor_bank_form_acme.pdf and W9. To finalize ACH setup we need either: (A) a completed bank confirmation via DocuSign (link below) OR (B) to verify micro-deposit(s).
- We will send a DocuSign packet titled "Redwood Vendor Bank Confirmation" to the signer on file unless you prefer the micro-deposit method. DocuSign is faster for our processes and avoids delays caused by banking cutoffs.

DocuSign link: https://app.docusign.com/12345678-example

Banking/wire notes:
- If you opt for wire instead of ACH for the initial payment, include the intermediary bank details if applicable.
- For remittance, please send remittance advice to payments@redwood.ai and include: PO number, invoice number, invoice date, total, and one-line itemization. That allows our automated apply to match the payment.

I will initiate the DocuSign flow today. Once completed we will perform a $0.10 micro-deposit (if you chose that), confirm the amount, and then mark the vendor as PAYMENT-ENABLED in our system. Marissa — once vendor is enabled, we will notify you to proceed with the PO issuance.

Attachments: AP_vendor_onboard_checklist.xlsx (referenced; internal)

Thanks,
Laura Bennett
Accounts Payable Manager
Redwood Inference
laura_bennett@redwood.ai

- Once you confirm the amounts, we will reply with a signed remittance sample and confirm your payments@redwood.ai address for future remittance emails.
- First scheduled payment (if ACH verified) is targeted for 2025-11-21; if wire requested instead, please notify us and we'll provide wire instructions and expected cutoffs.
